title: Metrics for healing loops in a tool
body:
### What would you like to be added?

We should log/track when smart edit (or any other tool) performs self healing, and should track latency of that healing loop.

### Why is this needed?

This will help us understand at what frequency this occurs and what latency it introduces to the user.

### Additional context

_No response_

linked_prs.title: fix(core): add telemetry support for smart edit correction events
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

This PR adds a new event `GEMINI_CLI_SMART_EDIT_CORRECTION` that logs when we attempt to fix a bad edit tool call.

## Dive Deeper

This will help us understand the frequency at which this event happens, and how often we succeed or fail.
